title: API loan approval reconciliation

steps.action: Read the requirement gate and record the chosen deployment/contract before generating runnable assertions.
steps.expected: If a required policy or capability is unavailable, return a Blocked/Unsupported report with the missing input. Do not guess business behavior.

setup: Needs controlled loan policy with known approval inputs and expected posting semantics. Public demo approval is not deterministic.
data: Dedicated deployment: loan=100.00, downPayment=20.00, source funds>=20.00; policy explicitly permits these inputs.
acceptance: Approval, created account and ledger all match pinned policy; otherwise a specific policy/setup blocker. Implement loan adapter and cross-channel assertions.
completion: All applicable setup and assertion steps pass with recorded evidence. Stop on setup failure and distinguish Blocked from product/assertion failure. Historical result is from the previous implementation run, not execution of this expanded specification.
